summary: ## What's Changed * MINOR: [1.18.x] Revert "Set version to 1.18.2 for release" by @manuzhang in https://github.com/apache/parquet-java/pull/3931 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apache/parquet-java/compare/apache-parquet-1.18.2-rc0...apache-parquet-1.18.2-rc1 The discussion centers on adding a new FINITE_VECTOR type to Parquet to support numeric vectors The FILE logical type can contain both inline data and a URI, leading to different readers returning different bytes. The proposal is to make inline data the authoritative source, treating locator fields as provenance only, and to clarify checksum semantics. The discussion focuses on compatibility implications and how to maintain spec compliance. The discussion focuses on finalizing the release process and ensuring all updates are compatible.
